title: Fix Arc Preview and Output
description: The arc command doesn't preview correctly (no curve rendering for arc/circle-outline preview kinds) and produces wrong output (kernel reads radiusPoint instead of start)
summary: Monorepo scripts consolidated to `script.ts` only. Policy lints use `export const policy` (+ optional `policyFile`) and `bun ./script.ts policy`; nx plugin matches `**/script.ts` with policy exports. WASM builds live in `puzzle/2d/rs`, `semio/client/lib/query`, and `semio/client/lib/rs` `script.ts`. Removed yak helper `*.script.ts`, all `lint.script.ts` / `*.lint.script.ts`, `build-wasm` scripts, and root `script.ps1`/`script.sh` (native bootstrap via `bun ./script.ts setup native` / `start` using ticket-embedded shells). Updated project.json, README, and @repo/lib docs.
